chapters: SCENE I. An open Place. — Thunder and Lightning. Enter three Witches.
SCENE II. A Camp near Forres.
SCENE III. A heath. — Thunder. Enter the three Witches.
SCENE IV. Forres. A Room in the Palace. — Flourish. Enter Duncan, Malcolm, Donalbain, Lennox and Attendants.
SCENE V. Inverness. A Room in Macbeth’s Castle. — Enter Lady Macbeth, reading a letter.
SCENE VI. The same. Before the Castle. — Hautboys. Servants of Macbeth attending.
SCENE VII. The same. A Lobby in the Castle.
SCENE I. Inverness. Court within the Castle. — Enter Banquo and Fleance with a torch before him.
SCENE II. The same. — Enter Lady Macbeth.
SCENE III. The same. — Enter a Porter. Knocking within.
SCENE IV. The same. Without the Castle. — Enter Ross and an Old Man.
SCENE I. Forres. A Room in the Palace. — Enter Banquo.
SCENE II. The same. Another Room in the Palace. — Enter Lady Macbeth and a Servant.
SCENE III. The same. A Park or Lawn, with a gate leading to the Palace. — Enter three Murderers.
SCENE IV. The same. A Room of state in the Palace.
SCENE V. The heath. — Thunder. Enter the three Witches meeting Hecate.
SCENE VI. Forres. A Room in the Palace. — Enter Lennox and another Lord.
SCENE I. A dark Cave. In the middle, a Cauldron Boiling. — Thunder. Enter the three Witches.
SCENE II. Fife. A Room in Macduff’s Castle. — Enter Lady Macduff her Son and Ross.
SCENE III. England. Before the King’s Palace. — Enter Malcolm and Macduff.
SCENE I. Dunsinane. A Room in the Castle. — Enter a Doctor of Physic and a Waiting-Gentlewoman.
SCENE II. The Country near Dunsinane.
SCENE III. Dunsinane. A Room in the Castle. — Enter Macbeth, Doctor and Attendants.
SCENE IV. Country near Dunsinane: a Wood in view.
SCENE V. Dunsinane. Within the castle. — Enter with drum and colours, Macbeth, Seyton and Soldiers.
SCENE VI. The same. A Plain before the Castle.
SCENE VII. The same. Another part of the Plain. — Alarums. Enter Macbeth.
SCENE VIII. The same. Another part of the field. — Enter Macbeth.
